Why would a home need precision under a millimeter? I think about it simply: parts that fit the first time mean less rework and less waste. BUILT® is laser-guided and designed for sub-millimeter precision.

Have you ever had a renovation where nothing lined up?
captions.linkedin:
Small errors compound. Precision at every step is what keeps them from adding up.

BUILT® is laser-guided and designed for millimeter and sub-millimeter precision. For scale: a standard credit card is 0.76 mm thick (ISO/IEC 7810).

What precision buys: components that line up when they arrive, fewer fixes after the fact, and fewer cut-and-discard mistakes.

The check I'd run on any build: How is it measured? How tight is the tolerance? What happens when parts don't fit? How is waste tracked?
